description_en: Retrieves information about all extensions in a specified database of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于获取实例目标数据库下所有插件的信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-postgres-extensions --db-instance-id pgm-bp156o9ti4930000 --db-name test_db --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePostgresExtensions

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The database name. You can call DescribeDatabases to query the database name
parameters.name: db_name

InstalledExtensions.description_en: The list of installed extensions in the specified database
InstalledExtensions.description_zh: 指定数据库下已安装插件信息列表

items.description_en: The information about an installed extension in the specified database
items.description_zh: 指定数据库下已安装插件信息

Category.description_en:
The extension category. Valid values:

external_access: external access.
index_support: index support.
information_stat: information statistics.
geography_space: geospatial.
vector_engine: vector engine.
timing_engine: time series engine.
data_type: data type.
encrypt_secure: encryption and security.
text_process: text processing.
operation_maintenance: application O&M.
self_develop: self-developed
Category.description_zh:
插件类别。

external_access：外部访问。
index_support：索引支持。
information_stat：信息统计。
geography_space：地理时空。
vector_engine：向量引擎。
timing_engine：时序引擎。
data_type：数据类型。
encrypt_secure：加密和安全。
text_process：文本处理。
operation_maintenance：应用运维。
self_develop：自研

Comment.example: PostgreSQL load profile repository and report builder

DefaultVersion.description_en: The default version of the extension

InstalledVersion.description_en: The currently installed version of the extension

Owner.description_en: The user to which the extension belongs

Priority.description_en:
The extension priority. Valid values:

0: displayed by default.
1: displayed with priority
Priority.description_zh:
插件优先级。

0：默认展示。
1：优先展示

Requires.description_en: The extensions on which this extension depends during installation
Requires.description_zh: 此插件安装时所依赖的插件

Uid.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID.

This parameter is returned only for exclusive extensions (extensions written by the user). Each Alibaba Cloud account can view only its own exclusive extensions
Uid.description_zh:
阿里云账号ID。

仅独享插件（用户自行编写的插件）会返回该参数。每个阿里云账号下，仅显示其自身的独享插件

UninstalledExtensions.description_en: The list of uninstalled extensions in the specified database
UninstalledExtensions.description_zh: 指定数据库下未安装插件信息列表

items.description_en: The information about an uninstalled extension in the specified database
items.description_zh: 指定数据库下未安装插件信息
